text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since Daring Tact and 
Efforia began joining the training 
sessions. As for Epiphaneia—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: I see, tuck the knees more softly—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...No! Running like this is no good at 
all! I'm doing it over!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaa...!!

She still hasn't regained her "usual 
self," but having the two of them watching 
seems to fire her up, and Epiphaneia is 
giving it her all frantically.
Furthermore, during break time—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
âSee! It's way tastier when you mix 
them! Strawberry Sweet and Mizore Sweet!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
"...This is really sweet. Is this the 
secret to Epi-san's strength too...?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Tact gets the version mixed with 
blueberries! Well? Delicious, right!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You're right, it has a sweet and sour 
taste like wild grapes... Delicious!

Epiphaneia was eagerly teaching all sorts 
of things to the two of them... though 
what she was actually teaching remains a 
mystery.
choice_data_list:
(Am I better at this than coaching 
training... maybe?)

(Am I better at this than coaching 
training?)

text_block_list.text:
At first, Epiphaneia tried to copy 
Cesario, teaching the fine details of 
training kindly and attentively. However—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So make it—not frumpy, but sharp and 
sleek! You got this, right?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, understood! I'll show you an 
example, so watch and learn!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
...I understand now. The swing of the arms 
is different, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this style really suits me better 
after all! I'm gonna go for a Kris S vibe!

From then on, Epiphaneia focused solely on 
"leading by example."

Having the two of them participate has 
definitely lifted Epiphaneia's spirits. 
And for the two of them as well—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! Incredible... Even though the sand 
there gives way so easily... what insane 
acceleration...!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Her axis isn't wavering at all... Her core 
strength is unbelievable. So this is what 
top-level is like right now...

The gazes of the two watching Epiphaneia 
seemed to grow more passionate with each 
passing day.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! So those two can find even more 
hints... I want to do a lot more running!

"I want to lead the two of them forward"— 
Within Epiphaneia, an awareness of guiding 
others that she had never possessed before 
was beginning to awaken.

"One evening, as those days continued, 
while relaxing on the beach to cool down 
after training—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hey, what are the two of your dreams!?
choice_data_list: What's up all of a sudden?
What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I realized I never 
asked! As a Trainer, isn't that the first 
thing you're supposed to ask an Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Since you both came to this academy, you 
must have some kind of dream!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Through victory... I want to 
prove the greatness of my homeland.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hokkaido. I was raised surrounded by its 
vast nature.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The harsh nature, and the warm people... 
Everything about that land made me 
strong――and I want to share its wonders.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I, raised by my hometown, achieve 
victory... then it becomes a victory for 
my hometown as well.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Is that so! What a wonderful dream!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...If only that could 
truly come true.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Participating in the summer training 
camp really makes me feel just how high of 
a level those running on the front 
lines—including Epi-senpai—truly are.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I found myself wondering... whether I 
could ever reach such heights.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, you'll be fine!! If it's you, you 
definitely――

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"‘Because you told me that I'd 
"definitely" be okay... I'll give it my 
all...!’"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I've been talking all about 
myself. Please, tell me about your dream 
too, F-senpai."

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
My dream... no, my destiny— is a GⅠ 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My family has achieved great results 
in the racing world for generations.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume carrying the family name, 
I must achieve results worthy of it. That 
means a GⅠ victory—that is my destiny.

Many girls from prestigious families 
connected to the racing world attend 
Tracen Academy. It's quite common for them 
to shoulder great burdens, but—
choice_data_list:
Is winning a GⅠ your dream because it's 
destiny?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will follow the destiny given to 
me.

She differs from Epiphaneia, who drove 
forward believing she was loved by 
destiny... but she, too, is a girl deeply 
preoccupied with destiny.
choice_data_list: (I wonder what Epi thought about it...)

text_block_list.text:
However, Epiphaneia kept her mouth shut, 
wearing a serious expression.

After seeing the two off to the lodge... 
just like after the Takarazuka Kinen, I 
invited Epiphaneia out for a walk.

Walking side by side with her like this... 
without any conversation, and without 
chasing after her, feels truly surreal.

“Yet, thinking that with every second that 
silence stretches, her thoughts are 
becoming organized…… it feels like deeply 
precious time.”
choice_data_list:
(I'll wait for you, no matter how long it 
takes.)

(I'll wait for you, no matter how long it 
takes, okay?)

text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't say it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I really wanted to tell you, 'I 
know you can definitely do it!'

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Normally, that's what I would've done. 
But... I just couldn't say it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because inside me... 'absolute' no longer 
exists.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If I'm not loved by destiny, how can I 
ever say anything is "absolute"?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I want them both to make their dreams come 
true! No, not just the two of them... 
Every single girl who felt that sense of 
destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I want to tell everyone that it'll be 
okay, that their dreams can come true! 
But—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know... if what I'm saying is 
right."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"What if what I said was completely wrong? 
What if following it led to a bad 
outcome...?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I think about it, the words 
get stuck in my throat... and I just can't 
say them."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: What is... this feeling?
choice_data_list: (...I think I kind of get it.)

text_block_list.text:
The feeling that arose when watching her 
interact with her juniors... I felt like I 
finally understood what it was.

"Because as a Trainer... that's how I 
always feel about Epiphaneia."

Having someone she wants to lead by 
example must have awakened her sense of 
duty as a guide. That very weight of 
responsibility... is making her hesitate.

"Now that the silhouettes of the girls who 
felt destined were clearly drawn before 
her— the omnipotence faded, and the voice 
revealed its true identity."

"Then the suffering Epiphaneia feels right 
now... is something one must 
experience—must endure—in the process of 
becoming an adult."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: This is so frustrating!! Uwooooooogh!!
choice_data_list:
（……Maybe I shouldn't chase after her 
right now.）

text_block_list.text:
Each and every one of them has a future 
all their own. And guiding someone is a 
heavy responsibility—a truth she now 
realizes.
